Perfect! I now have all the files. Let me provide you with a comprehensive report of the current implementation.

## Complete File Contents Report

### 1. **src/styles/global.css** - Full File (298 lines)

This is the main global stylesheet using Tailwind CSS with custom theme variables. Key features:

**Theme Colors:**
- Brand colors: Red/pink palette (#e94560 as primary)
- Cyan accent colors (#00d9ff)
- Geist Variable font for both display and sans-serif
- Custom dark theme (default) and light theme variables

**Key CSS Features:**
- Color system with CSS custom properties for both dark/light modes
- Gradient text utility (.gradient-text)
- Shadow and glow effects (.glow, .glow-cyan)
- Animation keyframes: fadeInUp, float, kenburns, pulse-soft, blink, modalIn, certSlideIn
- Badge styling (.badge, .badge-tech)
- Timeline styling (dots and connecting lines)
- Project card hover effects with scale and shadow
- Tech icon styling with scale-on-hover
- Tech popup/tooltip styles
- Slideshow background with navigation controls
- Section reveal animations with stagger effects
- Mobile navigation animations
- Modal overlay system with backdrop blur
- Certificate overlay animations
- Dotted background pattern utility

### 2. **src/components/SectionServicios.astro** - Full File (74 lines)

A services section component displaying 8 service offerings in a responsive grid:

**Structure:**
- Section ID: "servicios"
- Uses i18n keys for internationalization (data-i18n attributes)
- Heading with gradient text and cyan accent line
- 8-item grid (4 cols on lg, 2 cols on md, stacked on mobile)
- Items organized in pairs of red/cyan colors

**Services Listed:**
1. Full-Stack MVP (MERN stack)
2. Design Systems (Tailwind, Storybook, Atomic Design)
3. Auth & Security (JWT, OAuth2, RBAC)
4. Real-time Features (WebSockets, SSE)
5. Database Design (MongoDB/Mongoose)
6. Admin Panels (dashboards, audits, user management)
7. API Design (Express, Swagger)
8. DevOps (Docker, CI/CD, GitHub Actions)

Each service has an icon, title, and description with hover effects on icon and border.

### 3. **src/pages/ProyectDetail/[id].astro** - Full File (72 lines)

A dynamic project detail page with URL parameter `[id]`:

**Features:**
- `prerender = false` (server-side rendering)
- Queries project from projects library by ID
- Redirects to home if project not found
- Components used:
  - Layout wrapper
  - BreadCrumb for technologies
  - DataProyect (displays year, category, teamSize)
  - ButtonPrimary and ButtonSecondary
  - Icon buttons (GitHub, Live link, back arrow)

**Page Structure:**
- Back button linking to projects section
- Project title and metadata
- Technology badges with colors from skills library
- Project image (conditional)
- Long description (descriptionLarge, split by paragraphs)
- Call-to-action buttons (GitHub and Live preview)

### 4. **src/components/SectionProyects.astro** - Full File (33 lines)

A projects showcase section component:

**Structure:**
- Imports projects from library and filters by featured/rest
- Uses BlurFadeW animation component (client-load)
- Heading with brand color code comment style
- Two sections:
  - Featured projects (grid display)
  - Additional projects with "Más proyectos" heading (if any exist)

**Grid Layout:**
- 3 cols on lg, 2 cols on sm, 1 col on mobile
- 6px gap between cards
- BlurFadeW delay of 0.2s on second section

### 5. **src/components/Proyect.astro** - Full File (80 lines)

Individual project card component:

**Props:**
- `project: Project` interface

**Structure:**
- Rounded card with hover scale (1.03x) and shadow
- Image section with gradient overlay on hover
- Image lazy-loading with transform origin
- Content section with:
  - Title (with optional "Privado" badge)
  - Description (clamped to 3 lines)
  - Technology badges (showing first 5, +X for remainder)
  - Action buttons and links

**Interactive Elements:**
- Scale on hover (1.03x)
- Image zoom and translate on hover
- Gradient overlay appears on hover
- Buttons: Primary "Ver detalles" button, GitHub link, Live preview link (conditional)
- Uses BreadCrumb component for tech badges

### 6. **src/components/BreadCrumb.astro** - Full File (58 lines)

A badge component for displaying skill/technology tags:

**Props:**
- `name: string` (skill name)
- `color: string` (hex color)

**Features:**
- Dynamically imports icon from iconMap based on skill name
- Applies rgba background and border based on color
- Inline SVG icon with 10px size
- Click handler to show/hide tooltip description
- Tooltip appears at bottom of screen (fixed position)
- Tooltip auto-removes after 4 seconds
- Style utilities: hexToRgba and hexToBorder for color calculations

**Tooltip Logic:**
- Toggles tooltip on click (same click hides it)
- Removes existing tooltip before creating new one
- Uses data attributes for skill name and description
- Fadeup animation on tooltip appearance

### 7. **src/components/AboutMe.astro** - Full File (43 lines)

An About section component:

**Content Structure:**
- Two-column layout (grid, responsive with gap-10)
- Left column: Avatar image (avatar.png) with border
- Right column: Text content with metadata

**About Text:**
- Professional summary (DevOps & Software Engineer)
- Personal background (Swiss passport, Dominican origin)
- Tech stack specialization (MERN stack)
- Daily activities and passion for systems
- Languages and tools used

**Metadata Display:**
- Location: Jarabacoa, RD (with pin emoji)
- Languages: ES · EN · DE (A2) (with globe emoji)
- OS/Desktop: Arch Linux · Hyprland (with computer emoji)
- Editor: Neovim · LazyVim (with pencil emoji)

---

## Summary of Current Implementation

Your dhardi.dev portfolio is a sophisticated Astro-based website with:

**Technology Stack:**
- Astro (framework)
- Tailwind CSS with custom theme
- TypeScript
- React components (client-side interactivity)
- i18n for internationalization

**Key Features:**
1. **Dark/Light theme toggle** with CSS custom properties
2. **Responsive design** with mobile-first approach
3. **Smooth animations** (fade-in, scale, slide effects)
4. **Project showcase** with detailed pages
5. **Service offerings** presented in an 8-item grid
6. **About section** with personal details
7. **Dynamic tech badges** with click-to-reveal descriptions
8. **Color-coded technology tags** based on skill colors
9. **Card hover effects** with multiple transform states
10. **Proper SEO** with meta descriptions and dynamic titles

**Design Language:**
- Minimalist dark-first aesthetic with optional light mode
- Brand colors: Red (#e94560) and Cyan (#00d9ff)
- Geist Variable font throughout
- Generous spacing and breathing room
- Blur effects and gradient overlays
- Professional glassmorphism style elements

All files are well-structured, properly type-checked with TypeScript, and follow modern Astro and React patterns.
